CustomField.description: Technical formula to determine start date/time for Case Resolution time.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISNULL(Case_Picked_Up_Date__c), IF( ISNULL(Case_Reopened_Date__c), Case_Created_Date__c, Case_Reopened_Date__c ), Case_Picked_Up_Date__c )
CustomField.label: Date/Time Case Resolution Start
